rationale: Formatting, indentation and import-order changes only in controllers and ResultResponse; no behaviour change.
GenerateDto path and build size limit raised from max 20 to max 120 characters; previously rejected longer values are now accepted.
Adds test-only router constructors and renames a parameter; no handler behaviour changes.
Azure AD SSO migrated to MSAL4J; permission roles now derive from homeAccountId instead of uniqueId, and refresh logic changed, so role mapping and session refresh may differ.
Renames AutoTx to WithTx and lets nested transactions reuse the parent instead of returning an error; no request-visible change shown.
Only an import path of the session package changes; no logic change visible.
Question page canonical URL now also omits the title slug when the permalink setting is the short-ID variant; previously it included the encoded title.
Adds severity count columns to the scan Report ORM struct; no handler or response code shown using them.
Parameter rename, fun interface and comment fix; same behaviour.
Stop scan-all previously only stopped the execution in background; now marks a cache flag so the scan loop exits and returns an error response if stopping fails.
Startup check replaced by Jetty throw-on-unavailable only for required contexts; other web apps failing to start no longer abort server startup.
Adds a deprecation log call at flow initialization; no API-visible effect.
Process update now starts from the stored config, so omitted fields keep current values instead of defaults; unknown id returns 404 before binding body.
Refactor of file manager method names, argument order and upload helpers; no behaviour change evident from provided files.
